Create a habit to start tracking expected check-ins. Unscheduled dates stay empty.
53 weeks · Weeks start Monday and end Sunday.

A day counts when at least half of expected habits are done. The first expected day below half during a streak consumes its rest day and keeps the streak alive without adding a day. If another below-half expected day occurs fewer than 7 calendar days later, the streak ends; a rest becomes available again after 7 days. Unscheduled dates are neutral.
